title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored Q6_K on one RTX 5090: LM Studio (llama.cpp) with MTP
slug_note: Forum-reported 72 tok/s decode and 2,430 tok/s prefill on a 5090 with a community uncensored Q6_K GGUF; the same thread shows a faster ninfer NVFP4 path.

engine.config: LM Studio / llama.cpp, MTP max 2, measured with llama-benchy; total GPU use ~28.5 GB (per post)

requirements.notes: 28.5 GB is the post's 'total GPU use' for this run, on a 32 GB card. Host was a 9950X3D with 96 GB DDR5-6400 on Linux. Not verified on a smaller card.

steps.text: Load it in LM Studio (llama.cpp backend) with MTP max set to 2
Benchmark with llama-benchy; the post gives no command line

measurements.method: herboh's llama-benchy run, MTP max 2 (per post table)
measurements.note: reported as 72.03 ± 5.66 tok/s; the post does not label the statistic or the concurrency

measurements.method: herboh's llama-benchy run, MTP max 2 (per post table)
measurements.note: reported as 2,430.18 ± 24.45 tok/s; prompt length not stated

caveats: Same thread, same 5090 (author herboh): ninfer with mixed NVFP4/FP8 measured 124.08 ± 10.56 tok/s decode and 8,143.82 ± 52.68 tok/s prefill (1.72x). Not recorded as its own setup because ninfer is not an engine in this directory yet.
Author notes tok/s varies heavily with output type, so figures from different prompts are not comparable.
The thread's original poster saw 31.60 tok/s on a different 5090 + Windows rig with the same checkpoint and Q6_K at MTP max 2 (not recorded here), so results vary a lot by setup.
Post does not give a command line, a prompt, a context length or a concurrency.

sources.note: Level1Techs forum post by herboh, 2026-08-24; backs the 72.03 and 2,430.18 figures, the 28.5 GB figure and the hardware.
Checkpoint used; size and licence from the Hugging Face API.
